calendarFaqs.q: When does school start in Lee County in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day for The School District of Lee County is Tuesday, August 10, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Lee County Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Lee County Spring Break runs March 13–17, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Lee County students return after Spring Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Monday, March 20, 2028. March 10 is a professional duty day, followed by the weekend and Spring Break from March 13–17.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Lee County students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Tuesday, January 4, 2028, after Winter Break and the January 3 professional duty day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school in Lee County?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Tuesday, May 30, 2028, with early dismissal.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the June 1–6 weather make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: Lee Schools reserves June 1–6, 2028 as severe weather make-up days. They may become school days if the district needs to recover time after closures.

calendarFaqs.q: Do Lee County students attend school on professional duty days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Students do not attend on the professional duty days scheduled for October 12, January 3, March 10, and May 31.

whatsNew.title: Changes from the 2026–27 Calendar
content: The first student day is August 10 instead of August 11.
Winter Break is December 20–31 instead of December 21–January 1.
Spring Break is March 13–17 instead of March 22–25.
The last student day is May 30 instead of May 27.
The severe-weather make-up window expands from June 1–4 to June 1–6.

rows: January 3 is a professional duty day. Students return from Winter Break on Tuesday, January 4.
March 10 is a professional duty day, followed by the weekend and Spring Break from March 13–17. Students return Monday, March 20.
Early dismissal is scheduled on both dates, so families may need to adjust pickup or after-school care.
These dates are reserved for severe weather make-up and may become school days if closures have to be made up.
